project.selected_title: CryptoGodJohn just backed a GTA6 microcap before Rockstar's next reveal...
project.dashboard_overview: CryptoGodJohn has made GTA6 his newest high-conviction meme-coin idea. Rubicon caught a John buy before he posted the thesis on @0x0papi, then he took it to his main account: GTA VI attention, Rockstar's August 27 reveal and a token that rewards holders in TTWO. John has posted about it constantly since. The three recording tabs put the whole story in order: all 75 posts across both accounts, the GTA6 chart from the first alert onward and the five buys our tracker caught. Ben can start with what John said, move straight to what the chart did and finish on the first buy alert.

packaging_review.notes: The recommended package avoids guaranteed returns, get-rich-quick language and misleading affiliation. Owner title and thumbnail approval is still pending.

reporting_stance.reportable_unit: What John posted or bought, the mechanism he described, and the public market and GTA VI context around it.
reporting_stance.attribution_rule: John's forecasts and comparisons remain attributed to John. Official mechanism and catalyst details are explained from their own sources.

audience_orientation.reason: Viewers need one fast reason traders watch John and one plain-English explanation of the unusual GTA6 plus TTWO setup.

items.question: Why do traders watch John?
items.answer: John publicly frames LINK, RSR and 0x0 as his previous high-conviction calls, which explains why his newest focused thesis attracts attention.

items.question: What is the GTA6 and TTWO setup?
items.answer: GTA6 is an independent Solana meme token that trades in a pool against Backpack's tokenized TTWO security; StonkFun describes TTWO rewards for eligible holders.

sections.purpose: Explain why John's concentrated calls get attention before introducing GTA6.

sections.purpose: Explain the TTWO reward mechanism and show the official GTA VI attention and August 27 catalyst.

cards.source_title: How the GTA6 and TTWO pairing works
cards.quote: GTA6 is the meme token. TTWO is the Backpack-issued tokenized security. The pairing is a market and rewards mechanism, not Rockstar ownership.
cards.shows: A one-glance flow from GTA6 trading to the TTWO pool and StonkFun-described holder rewards.
cards.why: It translates John's stock wording into a simple, accurate mechanism before official sources.
cards.inspect: Read left to right; end on the no-affiliation boundary.
cards.missing: Viewers may hear paired with stock and assume an official or collateralized Rockstar product.

cards.shows: Backpack Securities identifies itself as the issuer of the onchain TTWO instrument and Take-Two as the underlying company.
cards.why: It separates the Backpack-issued tokenized security from Rockstar and the independent GTA6 meme token.
cards.inspect: Issuer, identical TTWO mint and redemption/eligibility wording.
cards.missing: The mechanism is explained only through John or StonkFun, without the TTWO issuer source.

cards.shows: Rockstar's official second trailer and the enormous existing attention around GTA VI.
cards.why: It supplies the real-world cultural scale underneath John's meme narrative.
cards.inspect: Official Rockstar upload, title, channel and visible audience scale.
cards.missing: The video talks about global GTA attention without showing the official material driving it.
